name: Aquatic Disciple
body:
Those spellcasters who devote their lives to defend water creatures and emulate their abilities forsake their earthly heritages to become aquatic disciples.

Requirements

To qualify to become an aquatic disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Cannot be a creature with the aquatic subtype.
Skills: Swim 5 ranks.
Languages: Aquan.
Spellcasting: Able to cast hydraulic push. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the aquatic bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the aquatic bloodline.
Class Skills

The aquatic disciple’s class skills are Escape Artist (Dex), Handle Animal (Cha), Knowledge (geography, nature) (Int), Perception (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), Stealth (Dex), and Swim (Str).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8.

Table 7: Aquatic Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Blood of the sea, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Dex +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Aquatic adaptation, aquatic form (1/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Dex +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, blindsense 30 ft., aquatic form (2/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Con +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Aquatic form (3/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Cha +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Ocean lord	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
10th	+7	+5	+5	+3	Aquatic form (4/day), blindsense 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the aquatic disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Aquatic disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, an aquatic disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming an aquatic disciple, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Blood of the Sea: An aquatic disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her aquatic disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If she does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the aquatic sorcerer bloodline, using her aquatic disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, an aquatic disciple gains an occult protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As her body slowly grows accustomed to high pressures, an aquatic disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 7: Aquatic Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement

Bloodline Feat: Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, an aquatic disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer aquatic bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager aquatic bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Aquatic Adaptation (Ex)

At 3rd level, the aquatic disciple gains the aquatic adaptation bloodline power, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the aquatic disciple’s swim speed increases by 30 feet.

Aquatic Form (Sp)

At 3rd level, an aquatic disciple can assume the shape of an aquatic creature once per day. This ability works like beast shape I. At 5th level, this ability functions as beast shape III and can be used twice per day; at 7th level, it functions as beast shape IV and can be used three times per day; at 10th level, it functions as magical beast shape and the aquatic disciple can use this ability four times per day. Her caster level for this effect is equal to her effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for her aquatic bloodline.

If the disciple already has the ability to transform into an aquatic creature (as with a druid’s wildshape ability), she can instead use it one more time per day.

Blindsense (Ex)

At 5th level, the aquatic disciple gains blindsense with a range of 30 feet. If the aquatic disciple already possesses blindsense, she instead adds 30 feet to her blindsense range. At 10th level, the range of this ability increases by another 30 feet.

Ocean Lord (Su)

At 9th level, the aquatic disciple gains the amphibious special quality. If she already possesses it, she gains the aquatic subtype instead . The aquatic disciple also is constantly under the effects of freedom of movement when underwater.

Tremorsense (Ex)

At 10th level, the aquatic disciple gains tremorsense with a range of 30 feet when in water. If the aquatic disciple already possesses tremorsense, she instead adds 30 feet to her tremorsense range.
